scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web "npm run dev --workspace=@rapidfire/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@rapidfire/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc --project tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=@rapidfire/game-engine && npm run build --workspace=@rapidfire/contracts
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@rapidfire/server && npm run build --workspace=@rapidfire/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:production
